Get CFM Data from SMILES

Source: R/dev_CFM.R
get_CFM_data_from_smiles.Rd

Creates CFM_data object from SMILES by running CFM prediction and annotation.

Usage

get_CFM_data_from_smiles(
  smiles = "NCC(O)=O",
  compound_id = NULL,
  ppm = 5,
  adduct = "[M+H]+",
  check_cache = FALSE,
  cache_dir = tempdir(),
  force = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

smiles

SMILES string of the molecule

compound_id

Identifier for the compound. If NULL or empty, a random id is generated each call (see CFM_annotate_by_predict).

ppm

Mass tolerance in ppm (default: 5)

adduct

Adduct type (default: "[M+H]+"). Also accepts 0/1 (0 = "[M-H]-", 1 = "[M+H]+") and '-'/'+' as shorthand.

check_cache

Logical; forward to CFM_annotate_by_predict

cache_dir

Cache directory; forward to CFM_annotate_by_predict (default tempdir()).

force

Logical; ignore cache if TRUE

...

Additional arguments

Value

A CFM_data object containing fragment data
